name: @grapix/editor-workspace
description: GrapiX authoring application: the editor UI, its desktop shells, the project API and the MCP server.

scripts.build: npm --prefix .. run build:shared && npm --prefix .. run build -w @grapix/api-server && npm --prefix .. run build -w @grapix/editor-mcp && npm --prefix .. run build -w @grapix/editor-assistant && npm --prefix .. run build -w @grapix/adobe-mcp-gateway && npm --prefix .. run build -w @grapix/editor-web && npm --prefix .. run build -w @grapix/desktop-electron
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix .. run build:shared && npm --prefix .. run typecheck -w @grapix/api-server && npm --prefix .. run typecheck -w @grapix/editor-mcp && npm --prefix .. run typecheck -w @grapix/editor-assistant && npm --prefix .. run typecheck -w @grapix/adobe-mcp-gateway && npm --prefix .. run typecheck -w @grapix/editor-web && npm --prefix .. run typecheck -w @grapix/desktop-electron && npm --prefix .. run check -w @grapix/desktop-tauri
scripts.verify: npm --prefix .. test -w @grapix/api-server && npm --prefix .. test -w @grapix/editor-mcp && npm --prefix .. test -w @grapix/editor-assistant && npm --prefix .. test -w @grapix/adobe-mcp-gateway && npm --prefix .. test -w @grapix/editor-web && npm --prefix .. test -w @grapix/desktop-tauri
